messages:
Aisha Q.: Heads up — VertexLog (midmarket analytics) stalled after initial spike. Usage down ~55% week-over-week, renewal in 21 days. Onboarding shows 5/9 steps complete; integration devs cite flaky example payloads. Thinking a short "safety-lane" save: docs patch + targeted credit + pairing.
Derek W.: Can we get the error samples? If it's payload shape mismatch we can patch fast.
Aisha Q.: They reported `400 invalid_json` and `timeout` on large batch calls. Link to their logs: https://app.redwood/logs/vertex (internal).
Lia M.: Recommend 45m dev pairing to walk through batching knobs and a tiny sample corpus. Offer a 2-week activation credit (standard template) and an invite to a performance checklist session.
AM-Raj: Credit OK with Legal template. I'll prepare the customer-facing language and confirm AM follow-up cadence.
Derek W.: I'll prepare a minimal payload + cURL and a short snippet showing chunking & retry headers. Also toggle a temporary verbosity flag so we can correlate errors.
Aisha Q.: Action items: Derek to post sample and schedule pairing; Lia to book enablement; Raj to draft credit email and set weekly check-ins. Assigning Derek, Lia, Raj.
playbook-bot: New play created: "safety-lane-activation" (PL-6033).
Derek W.: Sample curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/ingest -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @small_batch.json`  will add to invite.
Lia M.: Paired session booked Fri 9am PT. I'll include a 6-step debug list: schema check, chunking, timeout tuning, retry headers, KV hints, eval set.
AM-Raj: Risk score 6/10 (activation friction + moderate cost sensitivity). If no progress in 72h escalate to exec sync.
Aisha Q.: I'll flag account in Gainsight as "at-risk-activation" and update renewal owner. Will post recap after pairing.
